product_brief: Modernized SoftHSM2 fork with OpenSSL 3.x, PKCS#11 v3.2, and PQC support, compiled to WebAssembly.
pqc_capability_description: Supports ML-KEM (FIPS 203), ML-DSA (FIPS 204), SLH-DSA (FIPS 205), LMS/HSS (SP 800-208), XMSS/XMSS^MT (RFC 8391), FrodoKEM, and Classic McEliece. Includes hybrid KEMs (X25519MLKEM768, etc.). Implemented in C++ (OpenSSL 3.6) and pure Rust engines. Validated against NIST ACVP vectors.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, LMS, HSS, XMSS, XMSS^MT, FrodoKEM, Classic McEliece, ECDSA (P-256, P-384, P-521, secp256k1), Ed25519, Ed25519ph, RSA, AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, X25519, X448, ECDH
key_management_model: HSM-backed (Software HSM via PKCS#11), KMIP 3.0 server for networked key management, crypto-agility policy engine (CACP)
architecture_type: Software HSM (PKCS#11 v3.2), WebAssembly module, KMIP server
latest_version: v0.10.0 (mentioned in CHANGELOG context), v0.4.24 (hardening sweep)
fips_validated: No (Supports FIPS 203/204/205 algorithms and FIPS 186-5/202 compliance, but no FIPS 140 validation status mentioned)
primary_platforms: WebAssembly (Browsers, Node.js), Native (Linux/Unix via OpenSSL 3.6), Rust
pqc_roadmap_details: Phases 0-19 completed through April 2026. Includes KMIP 3.0 server, CACP policy engine, hybrid KEMs, and Rust native API.
signature_schemes: ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, LMS, HSS, XMSS, XMSS^MT, ECDSA, Ed25519, RSA-PSS, RSA-PKCS#1
implementation_attack_surface: Addressed CWE-400 (WASM panics), CWE-120 (buffer overflows), RSA X.509 underflow, AES-CBC IV enforcement, ML-KEM secret zeroization, constant-time comparison for HMAC/KMAC, path traversal rejection.
testing_&_validation_methods: NIST ACVP conformance (320/320 LMS vectors, ML-KEM/ML-DSA/SLH-DSA vectors), PKCS#11 v3.2 compliance testing (193/0/1 C++, 257/257 Rust), cross-engine parity tests, Playwright E2E tests.
qrng_&_entropy_sources: Uses `getrandom` (js feature) for browser-compatible CSPRNG; DRBG testing mentioned.
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: WebAssembly target (~1.4 MB Rust engine), suitable for browser/Node.js environments.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Open source; dependencies include RustCrypto crates, OpenSSL 3.6; security audits conducted in March/April 2026.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Drop-in interchangeable engines (C++/Rust); PKCS#11 v3.2 API; requires OpenSSL 3.x for C++ engine.
